# rrealpath

> Leadership and executive coaching for a wide range of business challenges in Southeast Asia's cross-cultural work environments. Founded by René Anant Feddersen, based in Chiang Mai, Thailand. Coaching is delivered in Thai, German, or English — the language the leader thinks in. The site is fully bilingual (English and Thai).

## Core pages
- [Home](https://rrealpath.com/): positioning and overview
- [Coaching](https://rrealpath.com/coaching): the six areas where coaching earns its place, fluency across contexts, and the engagement structure
- [Resume](https://rrealpath.com/resume): René Anant Feddersen — experience, how the coaching is grounded, credentials
- [Connect](https://rrealpath.com/connect): two paths — for leaders/executives, and for HR/people/L&D placing a coach. Contact: coach@rrealpath.com
- [Thinking](https://rrealpath.com/thinking): editorial writing on decision-making, leadership, relationships, and cross-cultural work

## Notes
- Differentiator: native-speaker fluency in Thai, German and English, and fluency across SME and multinational contexts in Southeast Asia.
- Cross-cultural framing is a two-sided Thai–Western axis.
- Contact: coach@rrealpath.com
